title: rel0-4-0-os1.74: Sidecar 0.4.0 mods, OS 1.74 (older)
description: The same mods as rel0-4-0, built for OS 1.74, the OS Elektron offers now: drop the stock Analog-Rytm_MKII_OS1.74.syx. Has run on a real Rytm. You can move between 1.73 and 1.74 in both directions with Elektron's stock files; recovery is the stock file of the OS you want to be on. Back up every project first. The same file elekloader builds from core-0.1-os1.74.elemod + rytm-sidecar-0.4.0-os1.74.elemod with version 1.74 (sha256 538ae6fa...ab337). Goes with Sidecar 0.4.0 on the Pi.
